key.name: effect-enabled
key.summary: Enable optional Quick Settings background blur

key.name: window-material-enabled
key.summary: Enable optional Hyalune window background blur
key.description: Applies to managed Hyalune windows at the supported display scale. Text and controls retain their original opacity.

key.name: limit-background-refresh
key.summary: Limit only the optional backdrop to at most 30 updates per second
key.description: Foreground and native windows keep their normal frame clock.

key.name: diagnostics-enabled
key.description: Opt in to at most 120 one-second journal snapshots per activation. No input or application content is recorded.
